mapper.sql: command_id, order_id, user_id, total_amount, timeout_ms, items_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lease_owner, lease_until, last_error, dead_letter_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert ignore into async_order_command (order_id, user_id, total_amount, timeout_ms, items_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{timeoutMs}, #{itemsJson}, 0, 0, now())
mapper.select: select from async_order_command where status in (0, 1) and next_retry_time <= now() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < now()) order by next_retry_time, command_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update async_order_command set status = 1, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil} where command_id = #{commandId} and status in (0, 1) and next_retry_time <= now() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < now())
update async_order_command set status = 2, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, last_error = null where command_id = #{commandId} and status = 1 and lease_owner = #{owner}
mapper.select: select from async_order_command where status = 3 order by dead_letter_time, command_id limit #{limit}
select from async_order_command where status in (0, 1) order by command_id
